title: Does Deepening Alignment (Qi et al. Regularizer) Reduce Over-Refusal?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: The safety-utility tradeoff is a key open problem. Testing whether depth regularization affects over-refusal directly informs whether this technique is deployable without degrading user experience. High practical relevance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing the Qi et al. depth regularizer during fine-tuning, running RLHF baseline, and evaluating with both GCG attacks and OR-Bench. Custom training loop with a novel regularizer is beyond beginner scope.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two training runs (regularized + baseline), two evaluations (attack success + over-refusal), plus Pareto frontier analysis. Multi-phase project that is not feasible in 30 hours for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
